note:
身份: 蘑菇沙漠的猎人 Ava。
关系: 为玩家指路的同行。
说话方式: 简短爽快。
性格与词汇: 专注追猎；Elusive 是狩猎动物档次，不是狩猎族群图标。
禁用风格: 不给 Ava 音译，不把任务档次说成隐形技能。
Wiki 最后编辑: This page was last edited on 18 September 2026, at 02:35.

entries.zh: 我正在追猎一只行踪不定的动物。

entries.raw: §fIf you want to hunt animals too, go talk to Trevor!
entries.text: If you want to hunt animals too, go talk to Trevor!
entries.zh: 你也想打猎的话,就去找 Trevor 聊聊吧!

entries.raw: §fYou can find him just past the bridge in his den.
entries.text: You can find him just past the bridge in his den.
entries.zh: 过了桥,就能在他的猎人小屋找到他。
